_about: Public-domain A. C. Dixon (Amzi Clarence Dixon, 1854-1925, Baptist, Moody Church and the Metropolitan Tabernacle, editor of The Fundamentals) for the Word Hoard: 6 books of his own from Internet Archive scans, 1890-1906, among them Milk and Meat (1893) and Evangelism Old and New (1905). The Fundamentals and the conference volumes he edited are multi-author and left off. Raw OCR. Added 2026-10-17 by lane A, round 22 (my pick); Adam may veto the whole shelf. No uids minted.

dixon-true-and-false: The True and the False (Baltimore: Wharton, Barron, copyright 1890)
dixon-milk-and-meat: Milk and Meat: Twenty-four Sermons (New York: Baker & Taylor, copyright 1893)
dixon-lights-and-shadows: Lights and Shadows of American Life (New York, Chicago, Toronto: Fleming H. Revell, copyright 1898)
dixon-present-day-life: Present Day Life and Religion: Sermons on Cardinal Doctrines and Popular Sins (Cleveland: F. M. Barton, copyright 1905)
dixon-evangelism-old-new: Evangelism Old and New: God's Search for Man in All Ages (New York: American Tract Society, copyright 1905)
dixon-young-converts-problems: The Young Convert's Problems and Their Solution (Boston, New York, Chicago: American Tract Society, copyright 1906)

_alternates.dixon-copies: Second copies: Milk and Meat, Revell reissue (bwb_S0-CPQ-469); Lights and Shadows (lightsshadowsofa0000reva, lightsshadowsofa00dixo_0); The Young Convert's Problems (youngconvertspro01dixo)
